ValidationRule.description: There is only 1 product on the Opp, if it is NOT Cross Border Payment, Pricing Ticket Link is required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", XBP_Only__c = FALSE, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal")), ofProducts__c = 1, ISBLANK(Pricing_Ticket_Link__c), DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > DATEVALUE("2022-06-30"), Probability >0.95 ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Must have a Jira Pricing Ticket Linked to Close Won this Opp. Refer to your Vertical Lead or Pricing Team with questions.
